claims.text: From the accepted integral interval/Pieri presentation, the requested target is established for \(p=c=1\) and \(0\le k\le b:=\min(i,j)\): \(M_{d+k}\) has basis \(P_{x,k-x}\) \((0\le x\le k)\), and all positive-degree multiplication relations in degree \(d+k\) are exactly \(\sum_{x=0}^{k-1}\mathbb Z(C_x+C_{x+1})\), where \(C_x=P_{x,k-x}\).
